verse.verse_1: By the sky, (displaying) the Zodiacal Signs;
verse.verse_3: By one that witnesses, and the subject of the witness;-
verse.verse_4: Woe to the makers of the pit (of fire),
verse.verse_6: Behold! they sat over against the (fire),
verse.verse_7: And they witnessed (all) that they were doing against the Believers.
verse.verse_8: And they ill-treated them for no other reason than that they believed in Allah, Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise!-
verse.verse_9: Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness to all things.
verse.verse_10: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire.
verse.verse_11: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, will be Gardens; beneath which rivers flow: That is the great Salvation, (the fulfilment of all desires),
verse.verse_12: Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord.
verse.verse_13: It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life).
verse.verse_14: And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness,
verse.verse_15: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
verse.verse_16: Doer (without let) of all that He intends.
verse.verse_17: Has the story reached thee, of the forces-
verse.verse_19: And yet the Unbelievers (persist) in rejecting (the Truth)!
verse.verse_20: But Allah doth encompass them from behind!
verse.verse_21: Nay, this is a Glorious Qur'an,
